```{r plot}
### Fig.9 Visible light spectrum and normalized visible spectrum

zone_labels <- c(
  "Control" = "Control",
  "SH51" = "Shade 51%",
  "SH81" = "Shade 81%",
  "SH51-UV" = "Shade 51% - UV",
  "SH81-UV" = "Shade 81% - UV"
)

data <- data %>% 
  mutate(Zone = factor(Zone, levels = c("Control", "SH51", "SH51-UV", "SH81", "SH81-UV")), 
         PAR = as.numeric(PAR), Wavelength = as.numeric(Wavelength)) %>% 
  filter(Wavelength < 750)

df_norm <- data %>%
  group_by(Zone) %>%
  mutate(PAR_norm = PAR / max(PAR, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

p2 <- ggplot(df_norm, aes(Wavelength, PAR_norm, color = Zone)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SH51" = "#66C5CCFF", "Control" = "#DCB0F2FF", "SH81" = "#F6CF71FF", 
                                   "SH51-UV" = "#FE88B1FF", "SH81-UV" = "#5A9E6BFF"),
                        labels = c("SH51" = "Shade 51%", "SH81" = "Shade 81%", 
                                   "SH51-UV" = "Shade 51% - UV", "SH81-UV" = "Shade 81% - UV", "Control" = "Control"),
                        guide = guide_legend(title = NULL))+
  labs(x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = "Normalized spectrum") +
        theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, vjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none")

p_atten <- ggplot(df_att, aes(Wavelength, T, color = Zone_shade)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = "Transmittance: Shade / Control") +
  facet_wrap(~Zone_shade)+
          theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, vjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none")

p_atten


leg <- get_legend(p1 + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

ggarrange(
  ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, align = "hv"),
  leg,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 0.12)
)

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
